FN-21Y6SSS-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 52
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/07/2025
House Bill 52 as introduced would reduce potential income tax receipts to the Education Trust
fund by an estimated minimum of $375,000 annually, for Fiscal Years 2027 through 2031, by
extending the sunset date of the Alabama Achieving a Better Life Experience (ABLE) savings
account program from December 31, 2025, currently to December 31, 2030.
Page 1

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 52
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/03/2025
House Bill 52 as passed the House of Representatives would reduce potential income tax
receipts to the Education Trust fund by an estimated minimum of $375,000 annually, for Fiscal
Years 2027 through 2031, by extending the sunset date of the Alabama Achieving a Better Life
Experience (ABLE) savings account program from December 31, 2025, currently to December
31, 2030.
